title.narrative: Support for the Global Data Access Initiative with UNGP

description.narrative:
Advancing SDGs monitoring and governance to accelerate implementation through innovative solutions and capacity building at scale". The joint program proposes a project aimed at strengthening the capacities of FSM’s local governments in advocating for the SDGs implementing multi-level governance. This includes providing essential advocacy tools for localizing the SDGs with policymakers and communities, assessing the local data ecosystem, developing a dashboard prototype, and facilitating reporting to accelerate SDGs achievement. The main objectives are: 
1. Enhancing stakeholder’s advocacy capacity for localizing and expediting SDG delivery, based on a robust evidence base to enhance monitoring utilizing a multi-level governance approach;
2. Strengthen collaborative partnerships between State Governments and civil society organizations (CSOs), promoting participatory SDGs advocacy; and
3. Mapping and enhancing data and digital ecosystems to develop or scale digital tools that accelerate and monitor SDGs progress, and maximize the effectiveness of development investments.
